description: Pick hybridization probes exactly as Primer3 pick_hyb_probe_only (internal-oligo picker; size/GC/poly-X/seqtm Tm/ntthal or, with thermodynamic_oligo_alignment = false, dpal self_any/self_end filters, Primer3 penalty order).

template.description: Template DNA sequence (probes are picked on this strand; case-insensitive).

thermodynamic_oligo_alignment.description: PRIMER_THERMODYNAMIC_OLIGO_ALIGNMENT: true (default) = ntthal Tm limits; false = Primer3 alignment-mode dpal self_any / self_end limits.

mishyb_library.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_MISHYB_LIBRARY as a name -> sequence object (primer3-py mishyb_lib), e.g. {"Alu*2": "GGCCGGGCGCGG..."}; an optional '*weight' (0-100) after the name scales that entry; IUPAC codes allowed. Each probe is scored against every entry and its reverse complement (Primer3 dpal, unanchored local alignment); reported as libraryMishyb/libraryMishybName.

max_library_mishyb.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_MAX_LIBRARY_MISHYB: maximum weighted library score of a probe (default 12).

wt_library_mishyb.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_WT_LIBRARY_MISHYB: penalty weight of the library score (default 0; needs mishyb_library).

lib_ambiguity_codes_consensus.description: PRIMER_LIB_AMBIGUITY_CODES_CONSENSUS: false (Primer3 default 0) = IUPAC codes in the library never match; true = they match every base they represent.

sequence_quality.description: SEQUENCE_QUALITY: one integer base quality per template base (length = template length, values within [quality_range_min, quality_range_max]); each probe then reports minSequenceQuality.

min_quality.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_MIN_QUALITY: minimum base quality of a probe (default 0; non-zero needs sequence_quality).

quality_range_max.description: PRIMER_QUALITY_RANGE_MAX (default 100); the quality penalty is wt_seq_qual x (quality_range_max - min quality).

wt_seq_qual.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_WT_SEQ_QUAL: penalty weight of (quality_range_max - the probe's minimum base quality) (default 0; needs sequence_quality).

wt_end_qual.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_WT_END_QUAL: accepted for Primer3 compatibility; no effect (as in Primer3 2.3.1).

opt_gc_percent.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_OPT_GC_PERCENT: GC optimum of the GC penalty terms (default undefined, as in Primer3's code; required when wt_gc_percent_gt/lt != 0 - Primer3 'Hyb probe GC content is part of objective function while optimum gc_content is not defined').

wt_gc_percent_gt.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_WT_GC_PERCENT_GT: penalty weight for GC% above opt_gc_percent (default 0).

wt_gc_percent_lt.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_WT_GC_PERCENT_LT: penalty weight for GC% below opt_gc_percent (default 0).

lowercase_masking.description: PRIMER_LOWERCASE_MASKING: reject probes whose 3'-terminal template base is lower case (a/c/g/t of the template as given; lower case elsewhere is accepted). Default false.

annealing_temp.description: PRIMER_ANNEALING_TEMP: annealing temperature in °C (<= 100; default -10 = off). When > 0 each probe's fraction bound at this temperature (Primer3 oligotm, at the probe conditions) is reported as bound and probes outside [min_bound, max_bound] are rejected.

min_bound.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_MIN_BOUND: minimum fraction bound, % (default -10; only with annealing_temp > 0).

max_bound.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_MAX_BOUND: maximum fraction bound, % (default 110; only with annealing_temp > 0).

opt_bound.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_OPT_BOUND: optimum of the bound penalty terms, % (default 97; must lie in [min_bound, max_bound]).

wt_bound_gt.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_WT_BOUND_GT: penalty weight of the fraction bound above opt_bound (default 0).

wt_bound_lt.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_WT_BOUND_LT: penalty weight of the fraction bound below opt_bound (default 0). As in Primer3 the internal-oligo bound terms are not gated by annealing_temp: without it the bound is OLIGOTM_ERROR -999999.9999, so wt_bound_lt adds wt_bound_lt x (opt_bound + 999999.9999).

libraryMishybName.description: Library entry of the libraryMishyb score.

bound.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_n_BOUND: fraction bound (%) at annealing_temp when > 0 (null otherwise).

errors.message: Template sequence cannot be null or empty
